title: 1998. GCD Sort of an Array

examples.explanation: We can sort [7,21,3] by performing the following operations: - Swap 7 and 21 because gcd(7,21) = 7. nums = [21,7,3] - Swap 21 and 3 because gcd(21,3) = 3. nums = [3,7,21]
It is impossible to sort the array because 5 cannot be swapped with any other element.
